title: Ex-GPH peace panel chair warns of 'tyranny of the majority' in BARMM Parliament

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Miriam Coronel-Ferrer, former chair of the Government of the Philippines (GPH) peace panel that signed the 2014 Comprehensive Agreement on the Bangsamoro (CAB) with the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), has warned that the new Bangsamoro Parliament could become “a tyranny of the majority” if its ruling bloc treats itself as the Government of the Day. “We can now glean how the Bangsamoro Parliament will operate when the majority is equating the Government of the Day with the Parliament,” Coronel-Ferrer said in one of a series of posts on her Facebook page recently.
